proceduralTechnicalFixtures.origin: Repository-authored procedural gradients, synthesized audio, subtitles, chapters, and plain fictional technical metadata; no third-party material is incorporated.
proceduralTechnicalFixtures.role: Secondary codec, subtitle, chapter, seek, audio, and download samples. The video sample (Audio and Subtitle Demo) has its own Samples library and the series (Sample Series) sits in Shows, so the CC BY open films are the only Movies catalog.
